newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Tata Steel raises $17 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: India's Tata Steel raises $17 mln loan.

text.p: Citibank said on Monday it arranged a $17 million 98-month syndicated loan for Indian steel maker Tata Iron and Steel Company Ltd (TISCO).
"The foreign currency loan, structured with an average life of seven years, and a moratorium period of six years, has been arranged to finance import of capital equipment," it said.

The offering, which was oversubscribed, was arranged by Citibank International Plc and was joined by Citibank N.A., Credit Lyonnais, Development Bank of Singapore Ltd, Sumitomo Bank and Syndicate Bank.
TISCO is India's largest private steel maker.
